WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
  WHERE f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py'
    AND s.name = 'BaseAgent' AND s.kind = 'class'
), agents AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
  WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM base)
    AND s.kind = 'class'
    AND NOT f.is_test
    AND f.file_name <> 'conftest.py'
), ctor_calls AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
         cf.is_test AS in_test
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.name = c.callee_name AND s.kind = 'class'
  JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = c.caller_file
  JOIN code.symbols caller ON caller.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
  WHERE c.call_kind = 'constructor'
    AND (caller.kind = 'function' OR caller.kind = 'method')
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id
FROM agents a
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctor_calls cc WHERE cc.class_symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND NOT cc.in_test)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctor_calls cc WHERE cc.class_symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND cc.in_test)

request:
Consider the agent classes defined in non-test code that directly subclass BaseAgent from auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py (every file under a tests/ folder, conftest.py and helpers included, is test code). Which of these agent classes are constructed (the class is called by name, e.g. ResponseAgent()) somewhere in non-test code but are never constructed anywhere in test code? Count only direct constructor calls written in a function or method body; patching or referencing a class without calling it does not count, and a test that calls a function which constructs the class does not count as constructing it. Return their class symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds non-test classes directly subclassing BaseAgent from the base module, then examines constructor call sites in function or method bodies. It returns classes constructed at least once in non-test code but never constructed in test code.
